Now I understand the issue clearly. The fix needs to be in the `replace_all` function in `util.rs`. The problem is that when the subject is extended (for look-ahead), the `replace_with_captures_at` iterates over all matches in the extended buffer, including matches beyond `range.end`. These extra matches and the content between them get included in the `dst` output.

The fix should be to limit the replacement to only matches that start before `range.end`, similar to how `find_iter_at_in_context` does it. But the issue is more subtle: even if we stop replacing at `range.end`, the `dst.extend(&haystack[last_match..])` at the end of `replace_with_captures_at` will extend the content beyond `range.end`.
